comparisons.peer_topic: Impact of ASU 2023-07 on Segment Disclosures
comparisons.peer_summary: In November 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-07, which enhances disclosures regarding significant segment expenses; this standard is effective for annual reporting in 2025 on a retrospective basis and will impact the company's disclosures without affecting its financial statements.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron (MU) disclose the adoption of FASB ASU 2023-07, which enhances segment reporting disclosures regarding significant segment expenses. AMD adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024, whereas Micron notes the standard is effective for its 2025 annual reporting, indicating a different timing of adoption for the same regulatory update.

The Company adopted this standard in the fourth quarter of 2024.
In November 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board ("FASB") issued Accounting Standards Update ("ASU") 2023-07 (ASC Topic 280), Improvements to Reportable Segment Disclosures.
This ASU is effective for our annual reporting for 2025 on a retrospective basis.
